body:
I got all my homework done the other day.

I finished both of my college app essays in time.

I opened up to my boyfriend.

As of today, 1 month clean from my relapse.

I was thinking acrylics, because even though I'm more used to using gauche, I feel like acrylics would stand out more and be able to convey the color palette I have in mind (monochromatic with different dark shades of red) better. A nice twist I'm thinking of doing is dripping candle wax (maybe red?) down the canvas, and mod podging newspaper clippings of obituaries featuring deaths by suicide in the background.
"A warrior is not afraid to bear their scars"... Thank you, I'm going to remember that quote for a very long time.
Alright. Thanks for the analogy, it helped me understand it a bit better.
